Package org.thewhitemage13.entity

Class Order

java.lang.Object
org.thewhitemage13.entity.Order
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
@Entity public class Order extends Object implements Serializable
Entity class representing an order in the system.

This class maps to the "orders" table in the database and contains all the details associated with an order, including user ID, items, address, status, total sum, product ID, count of items, method for easier logging and debugging.

Key Features:

  • Maps to the "orders" table in the database.
  • Contains fields for user ID, items, address, status, total sum, product ID, count of items, and timestamps.
  • Uses Lombok annotations for automatic generation of getters, setters, and constructors.
  • Includes constructors for creating an order with or without the updated timestamp.

Usage:

This class is used as a JPA entity to persist order data to the database. It is typically used in service classes to represent and manipulate orders. The class can be easily persisted using JPA repositories in a Spring-based application.
